fact.claim: On 2024-10-25 CloudFront stopped charging for requests blocked by AWS WAF: CloudFront customers never incur request fees or data transfer charges for requests blocked by AWS WAF.
fact.question: Since when does CloudFront not charge for requests that AWS WAF blocks?

values.display: never incur request fees or data transfer charges

qualifiers.scope: CloudFront pay-as-you-go requests blocked by AWS WAF
qualifiers.condition: the What's New post is dated 2024-11-06; AWS WAF itself still bills for evaluating requests

evidence.quote: With this change, CloudFront customers will never incur request fees or data transfer charges for requests blocked by AWS WAF.

changed.was: request fees or data transfer charges

fact.note: d133; register-15: the change date is the 'Effective October 25, 2024' of the post (posted 2024-11-06); older questions may assume blocked requests still cost request fees
fact.author: register-15

votes.reason: Quote supports "never incur request fees or data transfer charges for requests blocked by AWS WAF" but not the date 2024-10-25, which is absent from the quote and its context.
Dated change event; no later change item or newer corpus page replaces or contradicts it.
